# CountDays — Days Between Dates Calculator

> CountDays (https://www.countdaysbetween.com/) is a clean, fast, and modern web application providing accurate date duration math, business day counting, age milestones, and event countdowns without ads or bloat.

## Purpose
CountDays provides instant, mathematically precise calendar calculations for individuals, project managers, legal professionals, and financial analysts who need reliable duration math.

## Core Calculators & Tools

1. **Days Between Dates Calculator**
   - URL: https://www.countdaysbetween.com/
   - Description: Calculates the exact number of elapsed calendar days, full weeks, approximate months, and percentage of a standard calendar year between any two dates. Includes option to add 1 day for inclusive end-date counting.

2. **Business Days Calculator**
   - URL: https://www.countdaysbetween.com/business-days
   - Description: Measures working days between two dates by automatically excluding Saturdays and Sundays.

3. **Date Add / Subtract Calculator**
   - URL: https://www.countdaysbetween.com/date-calculator
   - Description: Adds or subtracts days, weeks, months, or years to/from any starting date to find the target future or past calendar date.

4. **Age Calculator & Life Milestones**
   - URL: https://www.countdaysbetween.com/age-calculator
   - Description: Computes exact age in days, weeks, months, and seconds lived, along with upcoming milestone dates (e.g. 10,000th day on Earth).

5. **Holiday & Custom Countdown Hub**
   - URL: https://www.countdaysbetween.com/countdown
   - Description: Offers live countdown timers for 80+ federal holidays, cultural events, and custom shareable countdown timers.

6. **Holiday Date Differences & Seasonal Spans**
   - URL: https://www.countdaysbetween.com/days-between/thanksgiving-and-christmas/
   - Description: Calculates exact duration, business days, and 5-year comparison schedules between major holiday pairs (e.g., Thanksgiving to Christmas, Memorial Day to Labor Day, Halloween to Thanksgiving).

7. **Calculadora de Dias e Dias Úteis no Brasil (Português)**
   - URL: https://www.countdaysbetween.com/pt/
   - Description: Calculadora oficial para o Brasil de dias corridos, dias úteis (CLT) e contagem regressiva para férias escolares e feriados nacionais.

8. **Calculadora de Días y Días Hábiles (Español)**
   - URL: https://www.countdaysbetween.com/es/
   - Description: Calculadora oficial en español de días naturales, días hábiles y cuenta regresiva para vacaciones y festivos en España y Latinoamérica.

## Date Calculation Rules & Methodology

- **Calendar-Based Day Counting:** Durations are calculated using standard UTC midnight-to-midnight date deltas.
- **Leap Year Handling:** Automatically includes February 29th during leap years (years divisible by 4, except century years unless also divisible by 400).
- **Business Day Rules:** Filters out weekend days (Saturday and Sunday).
- **Inclusive vs. Elapsed Mode:** By default, date differences measure elapsed interval days (end date minus start date). Checking "Include end date" adds +1 day to account for both start and end days being full active days.
